metadata.source: NASA Image and Video Library & NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day
metadata.description: Verified archival imagery of NASA observatories, deep-space astronomical surveys, and mission hardware with original NASA identifiers.

records.title: SPHEREx Spacecraft Nears Completion
records.description: The SPHEREx space observatory in a clean room following thermal and environmental vibration testing at BAE Systems in Boulder, Colorado.

records.title: SPHEREx Outer Photon Shield
records.description: Payload systems engineers at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory inspect the nested conical aluminum photon shields designed for passive cooling.

records.title: SPHEREx in Horizontal Orientation
records.description: NASA's SPHEREx observatory is rotated horizontally, displaying its triple-layered passive thermal radiation shield structure.

records.title: Andromeda Galaxy in Infrared (WISE)
records.description: NASA's Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer (WISE) captured this infrared mosaic of the Andromeda Galaxy (M31), highlighting dust lanes where stars are forming.

records.title: Hubble Ultra Deep Field (2014)
records.credit: NASA, ESA, H. Teplitz and M. Rafelski (IPAC/Caltech), A. Koekemoer (STScI), R. Windhorst (Arizona State University), and Z. Levay (STScI)
records.description: Ultraviolet, optical, and near-infrared composite of nearly 10,000 galaxies stretching back to within a few hundred million years of the Big Bang.

records.title: Earth and Moon from Galileo
records.description: Eight days after its encounter with Earth, NASA's Galileo spacecraft looked back and captured this remarkable view of the Moon in orbit around Earth.
